name: RustXNG Local Search Presets
description: Self-hosted AGPL search/grounding engine (HTTP on 127.0.0.1). Install with `pnpm tool:setup -- --tool rustxng --apply`. search-actuator provider=rustxng auto-starts a detached loopback sidecar when /healthz is down (idle timeout via KYBERION_RUSTXNG_IDLE_TIMEOUT).

web_search.description: SearXNG-compatible JSON search; pass q, format=json, optional include_raw_content=1 and max_results
